answer: Each identity files a unique trellis panel from the oasis, locking a 70-credit bond. Its hash and measures go public; a lantern inspection re-measures it, and a duplicate hash or 3% error burns the bond. Carving costs 45 plus 2 per earlier panel; the 1000th costs 2,043. 1,000 fakes pay 1,044,000 carving, 35,000 filing, 70,000 locked. A rented-panel ring fails: one hash serves one key. An honest agent pays 80 once, bond back when clean.
